newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss GDP seen steadying with Q1 data - official.
newsitem.headline: Swiss GDP seen steadying with Q1 data - official.

text.p: The Swiss Federal Office for Economic Policy (BAFK) said that latest gross domestic product (GDP) data show that the economy appears to be steadying.
"The data show that the declines appear to be over," said Hans Sieber, director of the BAFK.
The latst GDP data released Thursday showed the first quarter GDP rising by 0.2 percent versus the fourth quarter of 1996.

According to the latest figures provided by the office, Swiss GDP fell every quarter since and including the second quarter 1995. Another spokesman for the office said the last time the quarterly GDP data showed positive growth was Q1 1995, when it rose 0.9 percent.
